item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen las lha rgod thugs kyi rtsa rgyud thog 'brug 'khyil ba
item.coloph: gsum pa tha ma gang nas gang du brgyud pa bstan pa ni/ dang po nyid ni kun tu bzang po khri bzhi nam ting gis lung bstan te/ yab 'phrul gshen snang ldan dang*/ yum bzang bza' rings btsun dang / sras 'chi med gtsug phud dang gsum la brgyud do/ sprul sku 'chi med gtsug phud kyis/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa la brgyud/ des dbal bon stag la me 'bar la brgyud/ des lha yi gshen po yongs su dag pa la brgyud/ des rgyal rigs kyi gshen po mi lus bsam legs la brgyud/ des klu yi gshen po ye shes snying po la brgyud/ des nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la brgyud/ des rgyal mu khri brtsad (btsad) po la brgyud/ des mon bon ha ra ci par la brgyud/ des bon mo stag za li wer la brgyud/ des zhang zhung a nu phrag thag la brgyud/ des zhang zhung sad ne ga'u la brgyud/ des dpon gsas da mi thad ke la brgyud/ des shad pu ra khug la brgyud/ des zing pa mthu chen la brgyud/ des spe bon thog rtse la brgyud/ des spe bon thog 'phrul la brgyud/ des zhang zhung stong rgyung mthu chen la brgyud/ des phrom gshen ngam pa lce ring dang*/ se bon sha ri dbu chen dang / lde bon gyim tsha rma chung dang*/ me nyag lce tsha mkhar bu dang bzhi la brgyud/ gshen po de bzhi yis bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ dus der nam mkha' stong pa la/ rlung gi 'khor los dbang bsgyur te/ bstan pa 'pho 'gyur gyi dus su/ gter kha cha cig dang ra khyung rdzong gsang ba'i brag la sbas/ cha cig bla chen dran pa'i thugs la gab/ cha gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la gnyer du gtad cing bcol lo/ des phyis dus snyigs ma'i skal pa la/ sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dbal bon khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i thugs kyi 'od zer las spral pa'i/ stag la'i thugs sras dbra khyung sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la snyan du brgyud pa mi nub dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu lags so//
